label: SCG I.22 inseparable esse inherits its conjunction's source
paraphrase: OPEN selected reading of the second written case of SCG I.22 n.4, attribution deferred: at a selected world, for every esse e, proposed quiddity q and s, if e is joined to q, e cannot be understood without q, and the joining of e to q depends on s, then e depends absolutely on s (for its very being). Intelligibility apart is the primitive conceivableApart of the #1602 profile, not modal separation; conjunction dependence and absolute dependence are distinct primitive relations. No real-world instance is asserted.
